name: Sentiero Azzurro, Monterosso to Corniglia
why: The old mule path between three of the five villages, through terraced vineyards and olive groves, with Vernazza's harbour below you.
book: Cinque Terre Trekking Card or Train Card, compulsory on this path (checkpoints at both ends). Paths close after heavy rain: check the park's page the same morning. Train back from Corniglia.
water: Only in the villages: fill up in Monterosso and Vernazza.
dangers: Narrow steps with drops and no barrier; slippery after rain.
Very hot and crowded from June to August: start early.
turnaround: The park closes the path when rain is forecast: if it is closed, take the train. From Vernazza, the train is always the way out.

points.name: Monterosso al Mare
points.note: Start from the old town at the east end of the beach; the steps of path 592-4 climb at once among olive groves.

points.name: Vernazza from the path
points.note: The path drops to Vernazza from the north: the harbour, the castle tower and Santa Margherita church below you.

points.name: Corniglia
points.note: The only village on a cliff, 100 m above the sea. Station below: 382 steps or the shuttle bus.
